faqs.q: Does MentyMate diagnose depression or anxiety?
faqs.a: No. MentyMate uses validated self-assessment questionnaires (PHQ-9 and GAD-7) to help you notice changes over time. Only a qualified healthcare professional can make a diagnosis.

faqs.q: What happens if I express distress or crisis signals?
faqs.a: Our deterministic safety layer interrupts normal AI chat and immediately presents pre-reviewed local emergency numbers, crisis helplines, and trusted-contact options.

faqs.q: Is my check-in data shared with the WhatsApp Community?
faqs.a: Never. Joining the MateGroup WhatsApp Community is completely separate and voluntary; no mood logs or assessment results are ever shared automatically.
